title: Microsoft Teams → Google Chat & Meet Migration & Coexistence
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (Google Workspace + Gemini enterprise transformation; architecture/governance/integration or migration work, live-environment care).

Google Admin console + Microsoft/Entra authored click-by-click from public docs; Gemini Enterprise preview/rolling-out capabilities cited or flagged 'verify in tenant', never invented; third-party migration-tool and enterprise-app internals deferred to vendor docs.
hook: Move collaboration from Teams to Chat and Meet without stranding users
problem: Teams isn't just chat — it's channels, meetings, and files, and users are mid-conversation when you migrate. This solution moves Microsoft Teams to Google Chat and Meet with a spaces/channel mapping, meetings transition, coexistence during the cutover, and user-adoption guidance, so collaboration continues without stranding people, executed pilot-first and rollback-ready.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — the Teams → Chat/Meet model (channels→spaces, meetings, shared files, coexistence) and the deployment model.
Requirements Guide — prerequisites (source Teams access, Google tenant/licensing, tooling where used, a pilot) with how to verify/implement each.
Implementation Guide — exact steps to map Teams channels to Google Chat spaces, transition meetings to Meet, handle coexistence during cutover, run a named pilot, validate, and expand.
5 supporting scripts — Teams estate discovery, per-team migration/coexistence validation, a coverage/adoption report, safe remediation, and a wave target-group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides (spaces created, meetings work, users active) plus Best Practices for adoption and coexistence.
short: Migrate Microsoft Teams to Google Chat and Meet — channels→spaces, meetings, coexistence, and adoption — so collaboration continues without stranding users, pilot-first. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
